title: RPC-4000 Program W1-01.0 - BLACKJACK GAME
summary: How to set the tab stops, load the tape and place a bet — written for whoever sat at the machine.
description: The original program writeup by Mel Kaye for the Blackjack game on the RPC-4000 — the very program described in The Story of Mel. Written for the person sitting at the machine: how to set the typewriter tab stops, load the tape, place a bet. The preface page is photographed from the Bill Breiner Archive; the full document, preserved from bitsavers, is served from the Mel's Loop archive, and Mel's Loop holds a full transcription.
